about: Standing watchlist of themes that move money for an INR-based family office. Each month, analysis checks which themes were active in the news and whether their linked assets moved the way the theme implies. Asset ids match registry.py; catalyst keys match registry.CATALYSTS.

themes.name: Middle East and energy supply
themes.why_it_matters: Supply disruptions or OPEC+ decisions move crude, which feeds India's import bill, inflation and the rupee.

themes.name: US–China trade and tariffs
themes.why_it_matters: Tariffs and export rules hit emerging markets, global supply chains and semiconductors.

themes.name: Fed policy and US rates
themes.why_it_matters: Fed hikes lift the dollar and yields, pressure long bonds and growth stocks, and pull money from emerging markets.

themes.name: RBI and Indian policy
themes.why_it_matters: RBI rate moves and liquidity drive Indian banks, bonds and mid/small caps; the budget and GST set fiscal direction.

themes.name: AI spending and chip export rules
themes.why_it_matters: AI capex drives semiconductors and mega-cap tech; export controls and valuation worries can reverse it. Indian IT services can benefit or lose from AI adoption.

themes.name: Russia–Ukraine and Europe
themes.why_it_matters: Escalation or ceasefire moves energy, gold, European equities and defence spending.

themes.name: Dollar strength and global risk appetite
themes.why_it_matters: A strong dollar and falling risk appetite hurt emerging markets, commodities and crypto; it also lifts rupee returns on dollar assets.
